facts.business: Yasho Industries Limited is a specialty chemicals company with a consumer division and industrial business, engaged in manufacturing, R&D, and export of chemical products.

guidance_or_targets.statement: With improving market conditions, progressive ramp-up of recently expanded capacities, continued focus on differentiated products and export-led growth, the Company expects a gradual improvement in productivity and profitability going forward.
